ringcentral.quote: In order to work with particular RingCentral API resources, the application should have the corresponding scopes associated with it, also referred to as application "permissions." Required scopes are generally declared at the application registration stage and confirmed by the user during the authorization stage of connecting to that application.
ringcentral.excerpt: Application permissions and scopes: "In order to work with particular RingCentral API resources, the application should have the corresponding scopes associated with it, also referred to as application 'permissions.' Required scopes are generally declared at the application registration stage and confirmed by the user during the authorization stage." Scopes are edited per application in the Developer Console, and some restricted scopes require a justification reviewed by support before approval.

community-phone.quote: You will have to share information such as - PIN, Account number, Billing address as registered with the current provider, and a Letter of Authorization to Community Phone.
community-phone.excerpt: Porting intake on the vendor's port-landline guide, step "Authorize Community Phone to Port Your Number": "You will have to share information such as - PIN, Account number, Billing address as registered with the current provider, and a Letter of Authorization to Community Phone. Once this information has been validated with your current provider, the porting process will begin."

community-phone.quote: Community Phone will port your number in 3-5 business days without disrupting your service.
community-phone.excerpt: Provider-managed port on the vendor's port-landline guide: "Community Phone has a special porting process, unlike other telco providers. Through their hand-held porting, the company ensures that your dedicated rep stays in touch with you through the entire process, keeping you updated, and helping you through challenges." "Community Phone will port your number in 3-5 business days without disrupting your service."
